liveChecks: Loaded 96 anatomy meshes, 33 streamline files and both functional maps without reported runtime errors.
SCC default includes forceps minor and parolfactory cingulum with its original cingulum, uncinate and corticostriatal context; legend entries use the assigned colors.

Pre-SMA TMS enables superior corticostriatal and separate estimated pre-SMA–STN fibers. Left and right medial views select the corresponding file, clip lines at x=0, and leave the opposite hemisphere hidden. The STN endpoints have colored whole-STN context.

Pointer hover on the estimated pathway shows its approximate anatomical role and Ji citation in the existing offset callout. Other visible tract opacity is 0.425 (half its 0.85 base), preserving the prior hover behavior.
slMFB opens with bilateral VTA projection geometry. The caption retains its distinction from the separately selectable classical MFB.
BNST/ITP opens with both local ITP volumes colored 428f83 at 0.55 opacity; left medial view visibly separates the teal ITP segment from adjacent highlighted nuclei.
Selecting Li R2-18-1 enables only the OCD_RESPONSE fiber file. Changing the study to Tyagi clears Li selection and restores TR_A/CS_A suggestions.
Forceps minor alone, left medial view: only the ipsilateral half is rendered, clipping normal [-1,0,0]; the crossing source file remains intact.
All new families remain optional checkbox layers; regression coverage verifies URL restoration of the new families and custom selections.
No captured browser warnings or errors during the checked views. Screenshot: docs/public-pathways-v0.10.png.
validationScope: 36 regression groups; JavaScript and Python syntax; deterministic rebuilding of all new public geometry; desktop browser interaction checks for SCC, pre-SMA, VTA/slMFB, ITP and Li source selection. No patient-targeting or cross-template registration validation.
remainingLimits: New sources preserve native MNI2009a/MNI2009b coordinates alongside the existing MNI2009c cortex and AAL3 regions. No new cross-template nonlinear registration or millimetre-level targeting validation.
Pre-SMA–STN is an endpoint-filtered anatomical estimate, not a patient-specific or Ji-specific tractogram. Source selection is asymmetric: 460 left and 186 right, without mirroring.
ITP is now represented by a local segmented tissue volume; complete end-to-end fiber trajectories remain unavailable.
Exact Jimenez ALIC–OFC geometry, complete indirect DLPFC–sgACC streamline routes, and a specific structural right-insula–left-DLPFC route were not found in the audited releases.

Li geometry contains positive signed response weights only; these are normative associations, not significance or activation maps. Full released trajectories are not all labeled as pure hyperdirect fibers.
Study-specific electrodes, electric fields, patient tractograms, stimulation volumes and exact response intersections are not reconstructed.
Existing regional boundaries remain gross anatomical estimates; uncertain right bitemporofrontal/bifrontal terminology remains unresolved.

Lead-sourced files retain the complete upstream terms, including the atlas-specific commercial-use notice. Standalone IIT and Petersen assets with unresolved redistribution restrictions were not imported.
This pass checked desktop behavior. Phone-size, touch and assistive-technology audits were not performed. Saved links retain camera presets, not an exact freely dragged camera.
interactionPolicy: Mesh hover and click picking share the current display role: selected target/finding, enabled cortical region, or unspecified-side context. Background meshes remain visible but passive. Tracts and published coordinates retain interaction.
